facts.label: Champion of the Light rank 1 of 5
facts.value: Increases your spell damage by up to 12% of your Intellect, and reduces the cast time of your Hammer of Wrath by 0.2 sec.

facts.label: Champion of the Light rank 2 of 5
facts.value: Increases your spell damage by up to 24% of your Intellect, and reduces the cast time of your Hammer of Wrath by 0.4 sec.

facts.label: Champion of the Light rank 3 of 5
facts.value: Increases your spell damage by up to 36% of your Intellect, and reduces the cast time of your Hammer of Wrath by 0.6 sec.

facts.label: Champion of the Light rank 4 of 5
facts.value: Increases your spell damage by up to 48% of your Intellect, and reduces the cast time of your Hammer of Wrath by 0.8 sec.

facts.label: Champion of the Light rank 5 of 5
facts.value: Increases your spell damage by up to 60% of your Intellect, and reduces the cast time of your Hammer of Wrath by 1.0 sec.

facts.label: Unsealed Wrath (Retribution)
facts.value: Unsealed Wrath has 1 rank and sits on row 7, column 2 of the Retribution tree. It requires Repentance.

facts.label: Unsealed Wrath rank 1 of 1
facts.value: Your melee attacks store a copy of your active Seal for 15 sec, stacking up to 3 times. Landing an attack with a different Seal consumes all stacks, giving the stored Seal its normal chance to activate once per stack.
